suspicions.claim: The is_followed endpoint now checks if the target user follows the current user instead of checking if the current user follows the target user
suspicions.trigger: 1. Create two users A and B where A follows B but B does not follow A. 2. Authenticate as user A. 3. Call GET /api/me/following/<B's id>. 4. Observe that the response is 404 (not followed) instead of 204 (followed). 5. Authenticate as user B. 6. Call GET /api/me/following/<A's id>. 7. Observe that the response is 204 (followed) instead of 404 (not followed).
suspicions.evidence: Probe authenticated as user 1 and called GET /api/me/following/2 (user 1 follows user 2) and both base and head returned 204; then called GET /api/me/following/1 (user 2 does not follow user 1) and both returned 404, showing no reversal of follow logic.
